domain: Author equal-antipodal controls: q>=1, total mass1, G=alpha=Omega=D=1, epsilon_T<=2/25.
coefficient_bound: For real z=n epsilon sin(theta)/2, absolute Bessel series, n!>=(n/e)^n, e<3 and exp(y)<=1/(1-y) give |J_n(z)| <= b^n, b=(3 epsilon/4)/(1-epsilon^2/16).
odd_harmonics: Exactly zero; after truncating at16 the first omitted harmonic is18.
sum_bound: S=sum_{n>=18} n^2 b^(2n); includes odd n as a harmless upper bound.
power_bound: P_tail <=2 (q^(3/2)+1) S; P_leading >=(2/35) epsilon^4 q^(3/2); hence P_tail/P_leading <=70 S/epsilon^4.
monotonicity: For n>=18, b(epsilon)^(2n)/epsilon^4 grows with epsilon; use epsilon=2/25.
scope: Analytic harmonic truncation only; angular/Bessel numerical quadrature is not an interval certificate.
